subtitle: Keeping what you earn — the full Indian investor's tax manual after the 23 July 2024 changes: the capital-gains rate matrix with worked computations for every asset class, the ₹1.25 lakh s.112A exemption and grandfathering, specified debt funds under s.50AA, dividends and buyback after October 2024, bonus/split/rights/demerger cost basis, the complete transaction cost stack, F&O turnover and tax audit, set-off and carry-forward worked across years, advance tax with 234B/234C, ITR schedules, AIS reconciliation, LRS and Schedule FA, and the SEBI grievance routes.
